要点： 捕捉“迈步下台阶”的瞬间，身体侧对镜头，头转过来，眼神看向侧方，显得很生动。
Full body candid shot caught in motion. Stepping down a low concrete step. Body turned to the side profile. Looking sideways/away with a curious expression, mouth slightly open. Holding a green drink. The movement emphasizes the drape of the wide-leg trousers. Background is a trendy cafe entrance.
4. 🥤 嘟嘴卖萌·无辜感 (Pouting/Cute)
适用： 图4。展示妆容和甜美风格。
要点： 正对镜头，微微嘟嘴（Pouting/Duck face），双手自然摆放（或拿饮料），眼神无辜。
Waist-up medium shot standing in front of a Christmas tree. Looking directly at the camera with a cute pouting expression (duck face) and wide innocent eyes. Holding a drink in one hand. Shoulders relaxed. Soft lighting highlighting the texture of the purple sweater. Sweet, girlfriend-perspective shot.
1. 🍞 面包店·探身展示 (Bakery Lean/Playful)
适用： 图1。展示外套层次、长袖口以及上半身互动。
要点： 身体前倾靠近镜头（大广角感），一只手拿着装面包的袋子，另一只手向后伸展保持平衡，像是在说“看我买了啥”。
Medium shot standing in a bakery. Upper body leaning forward towards the camera lens (dynamic angle). One hand holding a clear plastic bag with toast bread inside. The other arm extended back for balance. Wearing wired white earphones. Smiling playfully at the camera. Messy layers of clothing vibe.

3. 🧎‍♀️ 侧身深蹲·折叠感 (Side Squat/Compact)
适用： 图3。展示鞋子、袜子以及侧面身形。
要点： 完全蹲下（亚洲蹲），身体侧对镜头，把自己折叠起来，一只手拿饮料放在地上，很显小巧。
Full body deep squat (crouching pose), viewed from the side profile. Knees bent fully. One hand resting on the knee, the other hand holding an iced coffee cup on the ground. Looking at the camera with a cute, upwards glance. 
4. 🎧 歪头整理·配饰特写 (Head Tilt/Accessories)
适用： 想要展示领口、项链、耳机等细节。
要点： 正面站立或坐着，歪头，手抓着衣领或耳机线，眼神无辜或搞怪。
Waist-up shot. Head tilted to the side playfully. Hands fiddling with wired earphone cables or adjusting the collar of the jacket. Wearing sunglasses on top of head. Direct eye contact with a quirky, lively expression. Background is a blurred supermarket or bakery shelf.
1. 🧎‍♀️ 乖巧蹲姿·拿饮料 (Crouching/Cute)
适用： 图1。展示鞋袜搭配、裙摆堆叠感以及整体的“小只”感。
要点： 双腿并拢或微微分开蹲下，一只手拿饮料撑在地上，另一只手托腮，非常乖巧。
Full body crouching pose (squatting). Knees bent deeply. One hand holding an iced coffee cup resting on the floor. The other hand gently resting on her cheek or chin. Looking at the camera with a sweet, soft smile. The pose highlights the skirt and socks. Cute, girl-next-door vibe.
2. 🪞 也是蹲姿·对镜自拍感 (Mirror Selfie Squat)
适用： 图3。展示手机壳、发饰以及上半身开衫细节。
要点： 蹲在展示墙前，单手拿着手机对着镜子（或对着镜头），另一只手整理头发，眼神看着手机屏幕或镜头。
Squatting pose in front of a display board. Holding a smartphone in one hand (showing off a cute phone case), positioned as if taking a mirror selfie. The other hand is touching her hair or collar. Knees are close together. Looking at the camera (or the phone) with a playful, engaged expression. Cheerful atmosphere.

4. 📐 上帝视角·大头俯拍 (High Angle/Looking Up)
适用： 图4。这是现在小红书非常火的**“大头贴”视角**，展示妆容、发饰、领口。
要点： 模特坐在地上，摄影师从正上方俯拍，模特抬头看镜头，手举着手机。
High angle shot (camera looking down from above). Sitting on the tiled floor. Tilted head back to look up directly at the camera lens. Holding a phone up towards the viewer. This perspective emphasizes the face and hair accessories. Big eyes, innocent expression. Gen-Z trendy photography angle.

2. 🧱 铁锈墙·侧身站立 (Rusty Wall/Standing)
适用： 图2。展示侧面轮廓和发量。
要点： 站在一面有质感的墙（铁锈红或纯色）前，身体微侧，手插兜，头发自然披散，眼神直视镜头。
Medium shot standing in front of a textured rusty red wall. Body turned slightly to the side. Hands in jacket pockets. A large tote bag hanging on her shoulder. Looking directly at the camera with a soft but cool gaze. Hair is loose and voluminous. Simple, clean street snap.
3. 😌 闭眼享受·橱窗前 (Eyes Closed/Storefront)
适用： 图3。展示氛围感，适合表现“逛街累了休息一下”的感觉。
要点： 站在玻璃橱窗前，闭上眼睛（Eyes closed），头向后仰，面带微笑，享受阳光，手自然抓着包带。
Full body shot standing in front of a large glass shop window. Head tilted back slightly, eyes closed with a happy, peaceful smile (enjoying the sunlight). One hand holding the bag strap, the other in pocket. Relaxed standing posture. Reflection visible in the glass window.
4. 📐 上帝视角·坐姿俯拍 (High Angle/Sitting)
适用： 图5。展示整体穿搭层次，特别是袜子/连裤袜和帽子。
要点： 坐在长椅上，摄影师从高角度俯拍（High Angle），双手拿着咖啡杯放在膝盖中间，腿部自然伸展。
High angle shot (camera looking down from above). Sitting on a wooden bench outdoors. Legs extended forward, showcasing boots and tights. Holding a takeaway coffee cup with both hands resting on her lap. Wearing a black hat. Looking to the side, hair covering part of her face. Trendy perspective.

2. 🚶‍♀️ 推门而出·拿咖啡 (Walking Out/Coffee Run)
适用： 图2。展示全身穿搭、长靴以及行进动感。
要点： 捕捉“推开玻璃门走出来”的瞬间，步幅要大，一手拿咖啡，一手插兜或自然摆动，戴着帽子。
Captured in mid-motion walking out of a retro cafe glass door. Taking a wide stride towards the camera. Holding an iced coffee in one hand. The other hand is relaxed or holding a bag strap. Wearing a black newsboy cap. Looking directly at the camera with a cool, focused expression. Street snap style.


1. 😙 坐姿提包·嘟嘴卖萌 (Sitting/Bag Lift/Pouting)
适用： 图1。展示外套蓬松感、长靴以及包包。
要点： 坐在水泥台或长椅上，双腿自然分开（显瘦），一只手把包包提起来展示，脸颊鼓起嘟嘴，非常可爱。
Sitting on a low grey concrete block. Legs spread comfortably apart to showcase the black boots. One hand holding the black bag up by the strap near her shoulder. The other hand resting on the block. Looking at the camera with a cute pouting expression (duck face), cheeks puffed out. Playful and youthful vibe.
2. 🦩 单腿倚靠·火烈鸟站姿 (Wall Lean/Flamingo Leg)
适用： 图2。展示全身比例、叠穿层次（露出衬衫下摆）。
要点： 一只手撑墙，身体倾斜，一只脚向后翘起（Flamingo pose），另一只手摊开或拿包，表情搞怪。
Full body shot leaning against a concrete wall or door frame. One arm raised high pressing against the wall. One leg bent backward at the knee (flamingo pose), foot lifted off the ground. The other hand holding a bag low. Head tilted with a playful, kissy-face expression. Dynamic balance showing off the layered outfit.
3. ✈️ 弯腰探头·飞机手 (Leaning Forward/Airplane Arms)
适用： 图4。展示外套背部/侧面，以及活泼的性格。
要点： 身体前倾，一只手向后伸展像飞机翅膀（或者拉着包），头歪向一边，眼神无辜。
Playful standing pose in front of a white door with graffiti. Leaning upper body forward slightly towards the camera. One arm extended backward (like an airplane wing) or holding a bag behind her back. Head turned to the camera with a quirky, wide-eyed expression. 
4. 🦵 踩凳侧坐·酷飒感 (Knee Up/Cool Sit)
适用： 图5。展示靴子细节和侧颜。
要点： 侧身坐在长椅上，一只脚踩在椅子面上（单膝竖起），另一只脚垂下，手搭在膝盖上，笑容自信温婉。
Sitting sideways on a stone bench. One leg dropped down naturally, the other knee bent with the foot resting up on the bench (knee-up pose). One hand resting casually on the raised knee. Looking at the camera with a soft, natural smile. Hair falling over shoulders. Relaxed city break vibe.
走路经过街角的彩色造型装饰物边。身体微微侧转在向前行走中，回眸看向镜头，嘴角带着温柔笑意。大风将她的头发吹乱，营造出随性凌乱的氛围感。身材匀称高挑，一只手拿着饮品，另一只手挎着包。画面整体时尚高级走，路像拍模摄特。儿在路上画面自然、无摆拍痕迹，充满走走停停的旅行随性感。
